members.text: This walkthrough follows the same path as the written tutorial. It runs in guided mode, which pauses after each beat. Turn Guided mode off in the player controls to watch continuously. The tutorial workspace begins with a generated terminal beat. Run Tiny Canvas with the original Sunset Study artwork. The command hands the editor to the browser beat you will add.

The learner writes one complete browser beat and then improves that same beat throughout the tutorial. Rename the artwork Coconut Sunset. Move the sun toward the horizon, where the tree partly covers it. Reposition the coconut tree on the beach, then save the edited artwork as a new file. The finished two-beat video can now be extended with narration anchors and this guided checkpoint without authoring another complete beat.
